title: Customer app with a payment gateway
description: Mercado Pago with card tokenization, 3D Secure and PDF receipts; alternative methods through BBVA, PayCash, PuntoRed and GestoPago. Two-factor authentication, biometrics, session control and CURP/RFC validation.

title: Corporate site from scratch
description: Landing page, product microsites, contact forms and a branch locator with Google Maps. Lighthouse optimization, WebP images and SEO, consuming the in-house CMS.

title: Self-service CMS
description: WYSIWYG editor, banner and FAQ management, media library, brand configuration, roles and permissions with an audit trail, and operations dashboards integrating Power BI.

title: iOS and Android apps
description: Maintenance and evolution of the native apps and of their communication layer with the web application, including version management and releases on the App Store and Google Play.

title: Storefront with Medusa and Stripe
description: Next.js store with Medusa and Stripe, localized to Mexican Spanish and with a design system documented in Storybook.

title: Internal invoicing, 80% less time
description: Optimization of the internal invoicing process of a .NET suite on SQL Server, and standardization of the frontend with a design system alongside design and QA.
